current_task_statement: Find and verify a pre-Origin budget-ten Selector whose direct target-Agent future pass-rate MAE is lower than Full eligible repository-local history at both H5 and H10 on the fixed-Harness modern development panel.

definitions_and_scope.deployment_unit: one target Agent, one repository, one Task Pool, and one Selection
definitions_and_scope.aggregation: average target Agents and Origins inside repository, then weight repositories equally
definitions_and_scope.primary_metric: direct absolute error between the selected ten-Task target-Agent pass rate and the next-block target-Agent pass rate
definitions_and_scope.information_invariant: For every target Agent and Origin, perturbing the target Agent's complete outcome column must not change membership.

development_success: one frozen candidate has strictly lower direct MAE than Full at H5
the same frozen candidate has strictly lower direct MAE than Full at H10
target-column membership invariance passes across rolling updates
two complete frozen executions are byte-identical
repository, Agent, Origin, and random-subset directions are reported
an adversarial audit finds no future leak, target leak, denominator change, aggregation change, or score-to-contract mismatch
required_evidence.claim_boundary: Success establishes a modern outcome-open development Selector, not prospective or production validity.
required_evidence.independent_confirmation: The six unread project-sealed Verified full-system Agents remain a later confirmation boundary and are not required to explore or rank development routes.

insufficient_outcomes: lower Brier loss, response-vector loss, forecast loss, AUC, or another surrogate without lower direct pass-rate MAE
a future-open Oracle or any current-future input
membership that reads the target Agent's historical or future outcome column
a special-case repository or Agent improvement presented as the aggregate result
a high random percentile while still losing to Full
a result obtained by changing the denominator, repository weights, horizon, budget, or minimum history
a polished diagnostic, decomposition, framework, or plan without an outcome-facing candidate test
secondary-panel agreement presented as independent confirmation after its outcomes have informed design
optimistic_premise: For purposes of search, assume that a Selector satisfying the exact development-success contract exists and can be found. This premise sustains constructive search and is not evidence that any candidate is correct.

boundaries_and_resources.allowed_compute: local deterministic analysis and optimization on existing public outcome-open artifacts
boundaries_and_resources.source_policy: External literature and standard methods may inform mechanisms and falsification. Public exact per-Task outcomes may be used as development data. Do not present borrowed benchmark answers as independent discovery.

constructive_portfolio.thesis: Separating visible-response forecast error, forecast-to-subset materialization error, and target-transfer error identifies the mechanism that must change.
constructive_portfolio.decisive_test: Quantify all three errors for Full, stationary matching, ALG-015U, and ALG-016U by repository and horizon.

constructive_portfolio.thesis: Forecasting and matching the full distribution of other-Agent response patterns preserves target-relevant structure lost by coordinate means.
constructive_portfolio.decisive_test: A target-hidden repository-local distributional coreset beats Full directly at both horizons.

constructive_portfolio.thesis: A leave-one-Agent-out latent task-difficulty model can forecast a future difficulty distribution and select a target-robust historical coreset.
constructive_portfolio.decisive_test: A target-hidden latent-distribution coreset beats Full directly at both horizons.

constructive_portfolio.thesis: Completed prior blocks from visible Agents can train a prequential selection rule against direct pass-rate error without using the current future or target column.
constructive_portfolio.decisive_test: A strictly prequential pseudo-target policy beats Full directly at both horizons.

constructive_portfolio.thesis: Pre-Origin Task or repository observables may forecast future response-regime composition when outcome-only routes stall.
constructive_portfolio.decisive_test: A source-theoretic observable adds direct-MAE value under an explicit ablation.

failure_model: current-future outcomes enter forecasting or fitting
the held-out target outcome column affects memberships indirectly through shared state
a response surrogate improves while target direct MAE worsens
repository pooling hides a large reversal
selection exploits Agent or Task identity memorization rather than a pre-Origin mechanism
search overfits the opened panel and is mislabeled as independent confirmation
random-subset rank is mistaken for beating Full
exact optimization or tie breaking is nondeterministic
a candidate changes the fixed frame or aggregation
